skill.name: remix-cache
skill.description: Guidance for using remix-cache in Remix applications with Redis-backed caching, typed cache definitions, TTL strategies, invalidation, SSE revalidation, and tests.
skill.summary: Build type-safe Redis caching and real-time revalidation for Remix apps.
skill.author: ChaseWNorton

content.value_statement: Remix apps need cache freshness without fragile invalidation logic. This skill guides Redis-backed caches, SSE revalidation, TTL choices, and tests.
actual_capabilities: Explains remix-cache setup for Remix applications with Redis configuration.
Shows typed cache definitions for loaders, actions, and reusable data fetchers.
Compares key, tag, pattern, and cascading invalidation strategies.
Guides SSE-based React revalidation with CacheProvider and useCache.
Covers testing patterns for cache definitions, invalidation, and React hooks.
Documents resilience options such as circuit breakers and request deduplication.
limitations: Requires an existing Remix application and Redis or a compatible managed service.
Does not include the executable remix-cache library source code.
Does not replace production load testing, monitoring, or security review.
External API examples require users to provide and protect their own credentials.

use_cases.title: Add Redis Caching to Loaders
use_cases.description: Plan cache definitions, TTLs, and loader integration for frequently requested Remix data.

use_cases.title: Design Cache Invalidation
use_cases.description: Choose key, tag, or pattern invalidation for product, user, blog, or analytics data.

use_cases.title: Validate Cache Behavior
use_cases.description: Create focused tests for cache hits, misses, invalidation events, and React revalidation.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Cache
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new Remix project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me add remix-cache to my Remix app. Include Redis configuration, one loader cache, and a safe default TTL.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Invalidation Rules
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate workflow for changing related data.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design cache invalidation for products, categories, and brands. Explain when to use keys, tags, and patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Add Real-Time Revalidation
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced React integration with server-sent events.
prompt_templates.prompt: Set up SSE revalidation with CacheProvider and useCache for pages that depend on user and product tags.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Production Cache Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my remix-cache design for TTLs, stale-while-revalidate, Redis failure handling, observability, and tests.

output_examples.input: Help me add Redis caching to a Remix loader.
output_examples.output: A setup plan covering environment variables, cache definition, loader integration, TTL choices, and connection cleanup.

output_examples.input: Debug why my product page does not refresh after an update.
output: Checks whether product, category, and brand tags match the cached data.
Reviews the action invalidation call and the SSE event filter.
Suggests a focused test for the failing revalidation path.

output_examples.input: Create tests for cache invalidation behavior.
output_examples.output: A test outline for cache hits, misses, tag invalidation, pattern invalidation, and React hook revalidation.

best_practices: Use stable cache keys and avoid placing sensitive user data in key names.
Prefer tags for related data and reserve broad patterns for controlled maintenance tasks.
Test cache misses, stale responses, invalidation events, and Redis failure behavior.
anti_patterns: Do not cache user-specific responses without including the user context in the key.
Do not rely on long TTLs as the only freshness strategy for mutable data.
Do not run broad Redis deletion patterns without checking the prefix and environment.

faq.question: What is remix-cache used for?
faq.answer: It helps Remix apps cache server data with Redis and invalidate stale entries predictably.

faq.question: Does this skill require Redis?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented library uses Redis or a compatible managed Redis service.

faq.question: Can it revalidate React pages automatically?
faq.answer: Yes. The docs cover SSE events, CacheProvider, and useCache for client revalidation.

faq.question: Does it support stale-while-revalidate?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill explains stale responses, background refresh, and TTL tradeoffs.

faq.question: Can it help with tests?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes patterns for unit, integration, and React hook tests.

faq.question: Is this a general Redis administration skill?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on remix-cache usage inside Remix applications.
